name: keynote-builder
description: Build Keynote (.key) decks that use the theme's real title/body placeholders instead of freeform text boxes, so slides inherit the theme's registered fonts, colors, and bullet styles automatically — no manual font-size or position tuning. Supports a Marp-like slides.md format for specifying exact per-slide content. Requires macOS + Keynote.app + uv.
